extracted.intended_audience: Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches and Research Support entries for NIH grant applications (e.g., SBIR/STTR, R21, R41)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the NIH biographical sketch and Research Support sections for senior/key personnel: include education/training, personal statement, positions/honors, contributions to science, full publication list, and detailed Research Support entries following the NIH form format and page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified NIH biographical sketch format exactly and keep each person’s biographical sketch to a maximum of five pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training (required fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study for each entry; start with earliest (baccalaureate) and include subsequent training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A narrative describing the individual's suitability and relevance to the project, including specific expertise and how the person will contribute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State why you are well suited for the proposed role, summarize relevant experience (examples: leadership, technical skills, prior related work), and explicitly describe your proposed role and responsibilities on this project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Employment
rubrics_metrics.description: A chronological list of positions and employment (with dates) and relevant memberships/honors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions/employment with date ranges and institution/company; include professional memberships and notable honors; format as concise chronological entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative descriptions of major scientific contributions with numbered representative publications supporting each contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the contribution in a short paragraph, then list representative publications (with full citation details and identifiers) that illustrate the work; include 2–4 representative examples per described contribution as shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the complete list of published work via MyBibliography (link).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a URL to the MyBibliography or full publication record so reviewers can access the applicant’s entire publication list (e.g., 'Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: http://...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support entry elements
rubrics_metrics.description: For each grant/award list grant number, dates, title, sponsoring agency, Major Goal, and Role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide: grant number (e.g., R21 AI138052), project period/dates, project title, sponsoring agency (NIH/NIAID etc.), 'Major Goal –' one-sentence description of the project goal, and 'Role:' designation (PI, co-I, Subaward PI, Key Personnel).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish Ongoing vs Completed Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate Research Support into 'Ongoing' and 'Completed' sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Group entries under 'Ongoing:' and 'Completed:' headings and list each project with the full entry elements; indicate current status and dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overlap disclosure for Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether there is overlap with the current proposal and, if so, describe it. (Examples show 'Overlap – none.')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each Research Support entry include an 'Overlap' statement (e.g., 'Overlap – none.') or describe the nature of any overlap/conflict with the current application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role designation clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly label the individual's role on each project/support (e.g., Role: PI, Role: co-I, Role: Subaward PI, Role: Key Personnel).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard abbreviations/titles consistently and ensure the role aligns with the responsibilities described in the Personal Statement and project documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation detail in representative publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Citations for representative publications include full bibliographic details and identifiers (journal, year, volume(issue):pages; PMID; PMCID; DOI where available).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete citations as shown in examples (author list, title, journal, volume(issue):pages, year) and include PubMed IDs (PMID) and PubMed Central IDs (PMCID) when available to facilitate verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide URLs for extended records
rubrics_metrics.description: Include links to online profiles or publication collections for full publication records (e.g., NCBI MyNCBI, personal bibliography pages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply direct URLs to the applicant’s full publication records or bibliographies so reviewers can access more extensive lists beyond the representative examples.
